title: One Waffle Each
subject: a British tourist at a Vienna hotel breakfast buffet who sets her alarm for six fifty-five every morning of the holiday to beat a German family to the only flip-over waffle iron, and on the last day finds the dad has left her the batter jug and a waffle already turning
caption: Minor-key dance-pop, mid-2020s club-leaning pop with a house pulse. Punchy four-on-the-floor kick, a rubbery plucked analog synth bassline, stabbing minor-key synth chords on the offbeat, tight open hi-hats and stacked handclaps on two and four. Glossy club mix, dry upfront vocal, short plate reverb on the claps. Female mezzo with crisp chest voice, half-spoken asides in the verses and a belted chorus. 122 BPM, A minor. Mock-dramatic, competitive and giggling at itself. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no ballad breakdown, no big-room EDM drop, no rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - plucked synth bass and kick, claps enter]

[Verse 1]
Six fifty-five, my alarm goes off in room four-twelve
Hair in a clip and my flip-flops on, I don't need help
There's a dad from Stuttgart with a jug in his hand
And one flip waffle iron in the whole of the land

[Pre-Chorus]
He's got long arms and a jug, I've got a plan
Pour, close, turn it, I'm faster than the man

[Chorus]
One waffle each, one waffle each
The sign says please, but it's out of my reach
Batter on my sleeve and the timer at three
Flip it like you mean it, that one's for me

[Verse 2]
Tuesday he brought the twins in matching yellow coats
Wednesday I was down before they'd boiled the oats
The lady with the eggs says you two should be friends
I said Grüß Gott, it's war until the holiday ends

[Pre-Chorus]
He nods at the jam, I nod at the cream
Nobody here is eating any muesli

[Chorus]
One waffle each, one waffle each
The sign says please, but it's out of my reach
Batter on my sleeve and the timer at three
Flip it like you mean it, that one's for me

[Bridge - bass and claps only]
Last day, case packed, the iron's already turning
A note on the jug says auf Wiedersehen, it's yours this morning

[Chorus]
One waffle each, one waffle each
He left me the batter and the jug in reach
Sugar on my sleeve and the timer at three
Flip it like you mean it, he made one for me

[Outro - synth stabs and claps, cut on the downbeat]
